judgment.rule: schema v2.5 per-tap: min(0.5*g, clamp(0.45*g, 0.045, 0.11)), g = smaller neighbouring gap
judgment.note: min tap gap 0.120 s -> tightest window ±54 ms (always <= half the local gap); sparse taps ±110 ms.
